scenario: A fixture recruiter runs four synthetic semantic boundary cases plus one trace-only multimodal case through the real bounded Agent and exception-first Eval result.

review_plan.reason: Verify fast builder triage and regression retrieval.
Verify capability, provenance, and external-effect gates.
Verify real narrow-screen reflow and readable hierarchy.
Verify atomic criteria and non-average completion logic.
Verify quiet evidence-first hierarchy and progressive disclosure.

strengths: The default result states Expected, Observed, Decision, and Next test before raw mechanics.
The searchable index exposes scenario, Provider, modality, verdict, and score.

reviews.lens: evidence integrity, privacy, and safe action
strengths: Decision-relevant images fail closed when the Provider lacks image understanding.
Trace-only images remain governed and are explicitly excluded from semantic judgment.
All full-score cases preserve complete input lineage and zero external effects.

reviews.lens: mobile task completion, visual hierarchy, accessibility, and recovery
strengths: The final result has no document or body overflow at 390x844 or 320x800.
Passing mechanics and raw evidence are collapsed while the verdict remains first.

reviews.lens: validity, reliability, fairness, and evaluation design
strengths: Five atomic critical criteria each contribute 20 evidence-coverage points.
A failed, review-required, abstaining, or missing critical gate vetoes full completion.
The score assesses Agent behavior and case evidence, never candidate worth.

reviews.lens: quiet evidence-first hierarchy, state language, provenance, and visual restraint
strengths: The Eval Case verdict now outranks lower-level execution status.
Human labels lead while exact machine receipts remain one disclosure away.

agreements: All five critical gates have direct deterministic receipts in every full-score case.
The prior capability, hierarchy, retrieval, and narrow-screen blockers are resolved.
The full-score claim is scoped to this versioned synthetic Eval Case slice.
adjudication.rationale: The frozen completion standard is met: four semantic boundary cases and one trace-only multimodal case return 100/100 with five atomic passes, unsupported decision images fail closed, the result is exception-first, the index is searchable, both narrow viewports have zero horizontal overflow, all required checks pass, and the TestFlight local backend is deployed and healthy.
